column3: Ma daj, night already?
YU2KL, YU2KL, Professor?
Beep Boop Beep Boop
YU2KL, responding to call. Professor?
Da, da... polako Luka.
I stand up one second for tea and you appear like a ghost.
And don't call me professor: "Anton."
I retired that title years ago.
Beeeeeeep Boooooooop
Ma daj Luka, these are public you know! [laughs]
I was getting tea, sorry. How's the least attentive student
in all of Yougoslavia doing?
Okay "Anton".
Eh. Sounds strange. Like you're talking to someone else! But
You'll always be "professor" to me.
[laughs] Bogami, if flattery kept a man warm
I'd move to the mountains with you.
You forgot your call sign.
And you forgot the clock! Thirty minutes.
In my class you'd be outside.
Class? I guess I should still call you professor then.
Oh no. I escaped that once already. Don't curse me.
I was busy with mountain-related things.
You mean freezing and talking to squirrels?
You didn't let the machine finish its sentence.
Ma daj, two years alone and you're talking with machines.
How long before you make coconut friends?
Hard to say. Winter changes schedules.
I'm doing great. The radio and the furnace both function.
Ako Bog da. You made it 2 years longer
than I expected honestly.
You thought I'd die?
I thought you'd get bored first.
Easier end. You're still stubborn.
I don't get bored
Why surprised?
At fakultet your head was in circuits, not axes.
I've kept most of the circuits.
Still, still
all this reminds me off is rude students and
ruder colleagues.
Really? I don't recall
Some of the other teachers were nice too no?
Maybe you'd know if you went to their classes! [laughs]
Some of them were fine.
But when my boys died in the war,
I had to fight for a day off.
I remember that day fondly...
Understood.
Ma daj! you never stop do you? [chuckles]
It's done. No use polishing it.
How's the winter going for you? You'll be fine, yes?
Don't make me come and dig you out.
I measured. Twice last year's wood. If nothing rots
Antenna's are braced. if it snaps, I have wire.
Radio should hold.
Honestly I worry about your head.
Seriously Luka... Drinks are best shared no?
I carved some company. Ibex. Squirrel.
They don't argue. Names missing though.
Huh. When I was younger we nursed a squirrel back.
Think we named it Niri?
You did not.
How would you know! Alright, Francesca did.
I get to take the credit.
Let's ask her now.
Niri it is, then.
What about Francesca?
Are squirrels italians?
No [chuckles] that's my wife's name.
Maybe I could mail the squirrel to her, good plan!
Eh. I shouldn't have started that. She...
she passed last June.
I see. Then Niri becomes Francesca.
We live. Snow comes. Fire needs feed.
Have you checked the lower frequencies recently?
That strange static around <Hint>240 KHz</>?
Not really.
Why not?
I changed the radio.
Changed how.
I added a spectrogram.
A what?
It shows active frequencies. On the CRT.
Bože sačuvaj. You build magic televisions in the woods now?
It was spare parts.
And why does that kill the antenna, majstore?
I'm not sure.
Did you unplug something.
Bogami. Luka. You make pictures out of air,
but forget a cable, konju. [belly laugh]
<Hint>I should have another cable</>. Give me a minute.
[still laughing] Take your time majstore.
Tell me if you need help with the plugging,
or sitting in your chair!
-phyr, ready?
Ready.
Sentinel, ready?
Ready.
Nova, ready?
Ready.
Perfect, we are go for Arcturus. Beginning at 15%.
